usageNote: 旅行建议常用句！语气像老妈叮嘱你，实用又温柔，不是命令哦～

examples.en: When traveling to Europe in spring, take more clothes than you think you will need.
examples.zh: 春天去欧洲旅行时，带的衣服要比你预想的多。

examples.en: My mom always says: take more clothes than you think you will need, just in case!
examples.zh: 我妈总说：多带点衣服，以防万一！
